explanation: Empty-password account audit. Usr_info -ep dumps accounts with an empty password field directly from /etc/shadow. Unlike SUID binaries or open ports, there is no legitimate reason for ANY account to have an empty password on a production system -- a count of exactly zero is the only acceptable state, making this one of the cleanest 'any occurrence is bad' checks in the whole bundle.

known_patterns.meaning: N accounts have no password set -- this is always a finding worth acting on immediately, not something to triage by count; even N=1 is a live, trivially exploitable account.

evidence_sources.default_meaning: Clean -- no accounts with an empty password field.

metadata.confidence: script mechanism verified (reads /etc/shadow directly); exact output filename and tag name are inferred from the temp-file naming pattern (/EMPTYPASS), not directly observed in a real XML file
metadata.caveat: Exact status_file/status_tag names are inferred, not confirmed against a real populated example.
